source_trace_findings.finding: The SIMPLIER path creates the endpoint extremity and calls dotPath.moveStartPoint for start decorations with an angle-derived movement whose magnitude is extremity.getDecorationLength().

moveStartPoint consumes at most one leading cubic when there is another cubic and the requested movement magnitude is at least the first cubic's XCubicCurve2D.getLength(). It then applies the residual to the surviving start point and first control.
The start tangent falls back from coincident first control to the first cubic endpoint chord, and getLength is endpoint chord length, not Bezier arc length.

The implementation mirrors the Java one-segment consumption shape: derive start tangent with endpoint fallback, test start_len against the first endpoint chord, drain exactly one cubic's three leading control entries, and apply residual movement to the new start/control.

forbidden_pattern_audit.notes: The implementation diff adds no new parity constants. It reuses endpoint decoration lengths already present with Java provenance comments and adds only algorithmic control flow in shortened_endpoint_points.

fixtures.finding: The preserved early Rust SVG matches Java for SourceBox-backto-TargetNode with four cubic segments and identical path data. The post-overwrite rustuml render reintroduces an extra leading cubic, proving the binary path was contaminated.
The target path has three cubics and a first visible chord of about 30.5px, so a 6px dependency start retraction must not consume it. Preserved Rust and Java segment counts match.
The path has one cubic, so Java's beziers.size() > 1 guard forbids segment consumption. Preserved Rust and Java path data match.

This covers aggregation start-decoration retraction under spline routing. The final path is one cubic, so it is decoration coverage rather than segment-consumption proof; preserved Rust and Java path data match.

The target Java path id is ParentEndpoint-backto-ReceiverTwo while Rust emits ParentEndpoint-to-ReceiverTwo. Path segment count is five on both sides and max preserved point delta is about 0.0034px. This is an unrelated ID/serialization residue, not a start-retraction counterexample.

counterexamples.description: After the target binary overwrite, rerendering the same input produced an extra leading cubic for SourceBox-backto-TargetNode. Because the executable hash no longer matches the initially observed requested binary, this rejects the evidence batch rather than the e8d50060 source mechanism.
